mapper.insert: INSERT INTO errand_order_event (order_id, event_seq, event_type, from_state, to_state, actor_id, actor_role, reason_type, reason, images, request_id, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{eventSeq}, #{eventType}, #{fromState}, #{toState}, #{actorId}, #{actorRole}, #{reasonType}, #{reason}, #{images}, #{requestId}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id, order_id, event_seq, event_type, from_state, to_state, actor_id, actor_role, reason_type, reason, images, request_id, create_time, update_time FROM errand_order_event WHERE order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY event_seq DESC LIMIT 1
